g.text: The CtyType hierarchy — what each type carries, and the four questions all of them answer
identity — is this the same type
substitutability — may a value of this type stand in for that one
the tfplugin6 type constraint Terraform is sent
go-cty's set-sort rank — it decides the order a set reaches the wire in
a leaf — validate cannot recurse, so @preserves_marks is affordable
one homogeneous element_type, any number of elements
a fixed shape: named attributes, or a fixed number of positions
an opaque native Python object — no wire form, so never serialized
the type is decided when a value is validated, not when declared
